lines.beaver: 선배, 요즘 채용 전망은 어때요? 걱정돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Senior, how's the hiring outlook these days? I'm worried.
lines.beaver_roman: Seonbae, yojeum chaeyong jeonmangeun eottaeyo? Geokjeongdwaeyo.
lines.learner: 요즘 경력자를 영입하는 추세야. 이력이 중요해.
lines.en: These days the trend is to recruit experienced people. Your background matters.
lines.roman: Yojeum gyeongnyeokjareul yeongipaneun chuseya. Iryeogi jungyohae.

lines.beaver_en: I'm a newcomer, so I don't have much of a track record.
lines.learner: 그래도 구인난인 분야도 많아. 걱정 마.
lines.en: Still, many fields have a labor shortage. Don't worry.
lines.roman: Geuraedo guinnanin bunyado mana. Geokjeong ma.

lines.beaver_en: Which fields have a labor shortage?
lines.learner: 광업이나 어업 쪽은 일할 사람이 부족해.
lines.en: Mining and fishing are short of workers.
lines.roman: Gwangeobina eoeop jjogeun ilhal sarami bujokae.

lines.beaver_en: What about industries with high turnover?
lines.learner: 이직률이 높은 곳은 고용이 불안할 수 있어.
lines.en: Places with high turnover can have unstable employment.
lines.roman: Ijingnyuri nopeun goseun goyongi buranhal su isseo.

lines.beaver_en: I want to be a dietitian. Would that be okay?
lines.en: Dietitians can get school appointments too, so it's fine.

lines.beaver_en: I heard the appointment exam is hard.
lines.learner: 맞아. 그래도 준비하면 백수로 오래 안 지낼 거야.
lines.en: True. But if you prepare, you won't stay jobless long.
lines.roman: Maja. Geuraedo junbihamyeon baeksuro orae an jinael geoya.

lines.beaver_en: Does the school also help arrange jobs?
lines.learner: 응, 취업 센터에서 알선해 줘. 꼭 가 봐.
lines.en: Yes, the career center arranges them. Be sure to go.
lines.roman: Eung, chwieop senteoeseo alseonhae jwo. Kkok ga bwa.

lines.beaver_en: Would it be better to change my desired field?
lines.learner: 사공이 많으면 배가 산으로 가. 네 뜻대로 해.
lines.en: Too many boatmen send the boat up a mountain. Follow your own way.
lines.roman: Sagongi maneumyeon baega saneuro ga. Ne tteutdaero hae.

lines.beaver: 선배, 영양사 일을 잘 아는 분이 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: Sunbae, do you know anyone who knows dietitian work well?
lines.beaver_roman: seonbae, yeongyangsa ireul jal aneun buni isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 우리 매니저님이 경험이 많아. 소개해 줄게.
lines.en: Our manager has a lot of experience. I'll introduce you.
lines.roman: Uri maenijeonimi gyeongheomi mana. Sogaehae julge.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Thanks, senior! That cheers me up.
lines.learner: 그래, 고용 시장 공부도 꾸준히 해. 화이팅!
lines.en: Sure, keep studying the job market too. You got this!
lines.roman: Geurae, goyong sijang gongbudo kkujunhi hae. Hwaiting!
